choices.text: Decrease. Two callers are harder to fold than one.
Increase, because more players mean more dead money you can always win

questions.explanation: Each extra player multiplies the chance someone has a hand. Value bet stronger hands and bluff less.

questions.prompt: A weak range realizes equity better when…

choices.text: It can check back in position or see a cheap card.

questions.explanation: Speculative hands and weak pairs need a low price. Big bets deny that equity.

questions.prompt: Before you choose a flop action, name…

choices.text: Texture, your hand class, position, and how many players are in.
Only the size of your stack off the table
Only whether you won the last hand
Only the suit of the cut card

questions.explanation: Those four facts decide bet, check, call, raise, or fold. Skipping one of them is how leaks start.

questions.prompt: A heads-up c-bet plan copied into a four-way pot is usually…

choices.text: Too loose. Multiway pots are for value, not for the same bluff frequency.
Required, because the math does not change

questions.explanation: Fold equity collapses as players are added. Keep the strong hands and drop the air.
